title: NSA purges Borland's JWICS document database

tellings.quote: So I had told you that in 2024 I had a large database saved of documents, briefings, private messages on classified on JWIX.

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, says that in 2024 he had saved a large collection of documents, briefings and private messages on JWICS, a classified US intelligence computer network, and that the NSA then wiped it. Borland tells this as something that happened to him, naming Intelink, the search system on those networks. If true, the government would have erased records he had gathered on the subject.
